description: Java source code for the AdHocApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing ad hoc queries in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: AdHocApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing ad hoc queries, including create, retrieve, update, delete, and template endpoints.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all ad hoc query data.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides a template for creating a new ad hoc query.

methods.name: createAdHocQuery
methods.description: Creates a new ad hoc query based on the provided request.

methods.name: retrieveAdHocQuery
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ad hoc query by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing ad hoc query identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAdHocQuery
methods.description: Deletes an ad hoc query by its ID.
